about.title: Who we are
about.p1: AloEgy is a voice AI platform purpose-built for Egyptian restaurants. We trained our agent on thousands of hours of authentic Egyptian Arabic dialogue so it understands how real customers speak — including slang, regional accents, and the back-and-forth of an actual order.
about.p2: The problem is concrete: restaurants lose 20–30% of phone orders during peak hours because the line is busy or staff are overwhelmed. AloEgy answers an unlimited number of concurrent calls and adds intelligent upselling that lifts the average ticket size.
about.p3: We integrate with the most-used POS systems in Egypt so orders land in the kitchen automatically. Our team is made up of Egyptian engineers building this technology specifically for the Egyptian market.

aboutPage.heroTitle: Building voice AI for the Egyptian market
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: We're a team of engineers, designers, and operators building the voice infrastructure that Egyptian restaurants run on.
aboutPage.missionText: Make every restaurant phone call in Egypt answered, accurate, and revenue-positive — without adding headcount. Voice is the most natural ordering interface; we're making it AI-native and dialect-aware.
aboutPage.storyP1: AloEgy started in 2025 from a simple observation: phone ordering is still how most Egyptian customers reach restaurants — but most calls during peak hours go unanswered. The lost revenue per restaurant runs into the tens of thousands of pounds every month.
aboutPage.storyP2: We built AloEgy because none of the global voice-AI players supported Egyptian Arabic well enough for real customer conversations. We assembled a team that combines voice-AI engineering, real-world restaurant operations experience, and an obsession with Egyptian dialect quality.
aboutPage.storyP3: Today, AloEgy is in pilot with restaurants in Cairo and is preparing to expand across Egypt and the wider MENA region.

dialect.title: Dialect-first, not dialect-last
dialect.desc: Egyptian Arabic isn't a localization step we add at the end — it's the foundation everything else is built on.

honest.title: Honest about what AI can do
honest.desc: We don't oversell. The agent does what we say it does, and where humans are still better, we say so.

operators.title: Built with operators
operators.desc: Every feature is shaped by feedback from real restaurant owners and managers, not just engineering preferences.

infra.title: Production-grade infrastructure
infra.desc: Voice runs on LiveKit, dialogue on best-in-class LLMs, and our stack scales to thousands of concurrent calls.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: AloEgy ("we", "our", "us") operates the voice-AI platform available at aloegy.ai (the "Service"). This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the rights you have over your data.
privacy.section1: We collect three categories of data: (a) account data you provide when signing up — name, phone number, restaurant name, email; (b) operational data generated when the Service is used — call audio, transcripts, order details, and timestamps; and (c) technical data — IP address, browser type, and usage logs needed to keep the Service secure and reliable.
privacy.section2: When a customer calls a restaurant using AloEgy, the audio is transcribed in real time, processed by an AI model to determine the customer's intent, and a synthesized voice response is generated. Audio recordings and transcripts are retained for quality assurance, dispute resolution, and product improvement, and are encrypted at rest. Restaurant administrators can request deletion of specific recordings at any time.
privacy.section3: AloEgy is built on a stack of vetted infrastructure providers, each with their own privacy and security commitments: LiveKit (real-time voice transport), OpenAI (language model inference), Soniox (speech-to-text), Hamsa AI (text-to-speech), and Supabase (database and authentication). We share only the minimum data necessary with each provider to deliver the Service.
privacy.section4: We retain account data for as long as your account is active. Call recordings and transcripts are retained for 12 months by default, unless your plan specifies a different retention window. You may request deletion at any time by emailing contact@aloegy.ai.
privacy.section5: You have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data. You also have the right to object to certain processing. To exercise any of these rights, contact contact@aloegy.ai and we will respond within 30 days.
privacy.section6: We use industry-standard security practices: TLS encryption in transit, encryption at rest, role-based access controls, and audit logging. No system is 100% secure, but we work to minimize risk and respond quickly to any incident.
privacy.section7: AloEgy is a B2B service for restaurants. The Service is not directed at children under 16 and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children.
privacy.section8: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will post the updated version here with a new "Last updated" date and, where the change is material, notify account holders by email.
privacy.section9: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Email contact@aloegy.ai or write to us at AloEgy, Cairo, Egypt.
